key_points: Stock rose ~3.7% on Oct 6 following Marvell's investor day highlighting AI-driven custom chip demand
Multiple outlets cite AI tailwinds and raise price targets ($400-$600 range), but no company-specific news
Mixed institutional flows: some funds trimming positions while others add, net neutral signal
Cautionary notes on valuation and 'story vs stock' disconnect from Seeking Alpha and 24/7 Wall St.
No earnings, guidance, M&A, or regulatory catalysts; move appears sector sentiment-driven
